lead.name: Vihaan
lead.trait: Ships the smallest thing that earns, then iterates.

title: Bake Cost
oneLiner: Recipe costing and price quote calculator for home bakers, on the phone, no install
customer: Home bakers and small cake sellers who price custom orders
revenueModel: Free single recipe, paid one-time unlock for saved recipes and quotes

evidence.claim: Cost A Cake Pro, a paid iOS app for pricing cakes, is listed on the App Store.
Bake Margin, a 2026 iOS app for baker recipe costing and margins, is listed on the App Store.
CakeBoss, desktop pricing and order software for home cake businesses, sells for a one-time USD 149 per user (5 reviews, 4.2 rating).
Bake Margin sells a Pro tier for baker costing, quotes and invoices at USD 3.99 a month, USD 24.99 a year or USD 59.99 lifetime; no rating count shown yet.
Cost A Cake Pro is a paid USD 4.99 iOS app, rated 2.3 from 15 ratings, which shows people pay but are poorly served.
An Etsy cake pricing spreadsheet for home bakers sells at USD 4.79 (shop shows 1 sale, no reviews).
A home baker on Cake Central asks how to price a custom fondant cake (USD 2.50 vs 4 per serving); replies say work out real costs and at least USD 10 an hour.
A home baker on Cake Central asks how to price a cheesecake, whether to count ingredients, labour and delivery (9 replies, 2018).
AGAINST: Craftybase offers a free cake pricing calculator covering ingredients, labour, overhead and margin, no sign-up.
AGAINST: BatterSuite offers a free cake pricing calculator with labour, overhead and margin; saved recipes and quotes are its paid tier.
AGAINST: Bakers Pricing Calculator charges USD 59.99 on iOS but shows only 1 rating, so paid standalone calculators sell weakly.

nextAction: Business case by research, then sizing, then CEO go or no-go. Research verdict: validated on demand (several paid products at USD 4.79 to 149 and bakers asking how to price), but strong evidence against: free calculators already exist (Craftybase, BatterSuite, cakepricingcalculator.pages.dev) and paid standalone apps show very few ratings or sales. The case must show a gap free tools leave.
